chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutevakil (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim quoted his father, on the authority of Al-Nawfaly, on the authority of Al-Sakoony, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his forefathers, that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said:

He said: When some of the wise men and the jurisprudents write to each other, they write about three things, with no fourth: Whoever makes the Hereafter his concern, God will suffice him his concern of the world; and whoever purifies his inner self, God will purify his outward appearance; and whoever improves what is between him and God, the Exalted and Mighty, God will improve what is between him and the people.
ai.seo_question: What are the three things wise men write about according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* highlights the triad of spiritual priorities—otherworldliness, inner sincerity, and divine connection—that define the conduct of the *Fuqaha* (jurists) and *Hukama* (wise men). It underscores the Shia emphasis on the unity of inner intent (*ikhlas*) and outward action, reflecting the principle that one's relationship with God directly influences social harmony. The narration serves as a practical guide for scholars to maintain integrity in both private devotion and public leadership.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-133 Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutevakil - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim quoted his father, on the authority of Al-Nawfaly, on the authority of Al-Sakoony, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq (MGB), on the authority of his father (MGB), on the authority of his forefathers (MGB) that the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (MGB) said, “When some of the wise men and the jurisprudents write each other they write about three things as follows.

God will provide for the worldly affairs of whoever engages in preparations for the Hereafter. God will purify the appearance of whoever purifies his inner soul. God will improve the relationship between the people and whoever improves his relationship with God.”
